title: How Taskin Goec Uses Clo As A Mixed Reality Designer
description:
Explore the story of Taskin Goec, a Mixed Reality Designer based in Berlin, who utilizes CLO in his entirely hybrid fashion design process. In this video, he will share his workflow, demonstrating how he moves from experimentation to producing high-fidelity visuals. His digital-first approach allows him to enhance his creativity, adaptability, and efficiency.

"I find that working with CLO is much more dynamic. It allows me to be experimental and quick and try out tons of different things up until the production level. Because designing clothes for production can be quite costly, and with CLO, I make this process much more streamlined." – Taskin Goec 

Find out more about Taskin's work here: https://www.instagram.com/taskingoec/  

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

--- 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/itsclo3d 
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/clo-virtual-fashion-inc-/ 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/clo3d/
transcript: My name is Tashken Goetsch. I'm a mixed reality designer and today I'm going to show you how I use Clos throughout an entirely hybrid process from experimentation to creating high fidelity visuals. I studied fashion design in Berlin and London. When I started studying I already knew how Clos were made so I could really focus on the question of what I want to do differently and also what is kind of specific for the time that I live in and for me the answer was technology and I decided to teach myself Clos 3D and Blender and create those worlds that basically become my universe and that today I call the technological swamp. So when I work I start experimenting in Clos. I create a pattern which I then plot and I create a physical prototype. I test this, I fit this on a mannequin or on a person. I do some amendments. Then I digitize those amendments so I bring all of this back into Clos and then in the end I have a digital and a physical twin. I find that working with Clos is more dynamic. It allows me to be experimental and quick and try out tons of different things up until the production level because designing clothes for production can be quite costly and with Clos I make this process streamlined. I work with different people from all across the industry. Right now I'm working on a project with knitwear designer Luisa Lauber and we are bringing together her technology which is this insane knitting machine and my workflow which is the digital first approach and we are developing a lot of new techniques that are truly mixed and that bring forth new structures and new knitwear techniques that we are confident will change at least part of the industry. Something that I'm also interested in is helping clients to navigate through the landscape of technologies like Clos and to find their own and unique ways of working with it even if it's not to create digital assets eventually and if it's to make their processes more more creative and more efficient and I believe that this is how we slowly move into a mixed reality. So thank you so much for joining us and we'll see you in the next video.
markdown_content: # How Taskin Goec Uses CLO as a Mixed Reality Designer This document details how Taskin Goec integrates CLO 3D software into a hybrid fashion design process, combining digital and physical prototyping. It covers his workflow, technical collaborations, and the role of CLO in experimental and production-level garment creation. --- ## Background and Approach to Mixed Reality Design with CLO Taskin Goec is a mixed reality designer with a background in fashion design from Berlin and London. Leveraging knowledge of garment construction, he focuses on integrating technology into the design process through CLO 3D and Blender. He describes his creative environment as a "technological swamp," where digital and physical worlds merge. - Studied fashion design with prior understanding of CLO garment construction. - Self-taught CLO 3D and Blender to create immersive digital environments. - Emphasizes the intersection of technology and fashion design specific to contemporary times. --- ## Hybrid Workflow: From Digital Patterns to Physical Prototypes This section explains Taskin’s workflow using CLO 3D, outlining the iterative process of pattern creation, physical prototyping, testing, and digital refinement. - Starts by experimenting with pattern creation in CLO 3D. - Plots digital patterns to create physical prototypes. - Fits prototypes on mannequins or live models to evaluate fit and design. - Makes amendments based on physical fitting sessions. - Digitizes all amendments back into CLO to maintain synchronized digital and physical twins. - This workflow allows rapid experimentation without incurring high production costs. - CLO’s dynamic tools enable quick iteration and refinement, streamlining the path to production readiness. --- ## Collaborative Projects: Integrating Digital Workflows with Innovative Technologies Taskin collaborates with industry professionals to push the boundaries of mixed reality and digital-first fashion design. - Current collaboration with knitwear designer Luisa Lauber. - Combining Luisa’s advanced knitting machine technology with Taskin’s digital-first CLO workflow. - Developing new knitwear techniques and structures that integrate digital design with physical production. - Aims to innovate and potentially transform parts of the fashion industry through these hybrid methods. --- ## Consulting and Guiding Clients in Navigating CLO and Mixed Reality Technologies Beyond his design work, Taskin focuses on helping clients adopt and adapt to emerging technologies like CLO. - Assists clients in understanding and integrating CLO and related tools into their workflows. - Emphasizes finding unique, client-specific ways to utilize technology, whether for creating digital assets or enhancing creativity and efficiency. - Views this guidance as a critical step toward broader adoption of mixed reality in fashion and design industries. --- # Summary Taskin Goec’s use of CLO 3D exemplifies a hybrid fashion design process combining digital experimentation with physical prototyping. His approach enhances creativity, accelerates iteration, and fosters innovation through collaborations and client education, contributing to the evolving landscape of mixed reality in design.
